# Two Ways to Run a Democracy

<!-- STEP id="representative" -->
## People Elect Representatives

They elect representatives, who answer to them at regular elections. This is **representative democracy**, or indirect democracy, and **India** follows it.

People do not directly govern, but the government is accountable to them.

<!-- STEP id="direct" -->
## People Decide Directly

In a **direct democracy**, citizens directly take part in most decisions, and some features of representative democracy exist. It is difficult in large countries. **Switzerland** is the example.
